newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Telstra pays Australia govt A$1.37 bln div.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Telstra pays Australia govt A$1.37 bln div.

text.p: Australian government-owned telecommunications firm Telstra Corp said on Friday its board had recommended a total dividend payment to the government of A$1.368 billion for 1995/96, 20 percent up on the previous year.
"Telstra's board has recommended a total dividend to the Commonwealth of A$1.368 billion for the year," Telstra said in a statement releasing its annual results.
"Taking into account taxes, interest and dividends, Telstra paid a total of A$3.270 billion to all governments, an increase of 20 percent on the previous year," it said.
Telstra earlier reported a net profit of A$2.30 billion for the year to June 30, 1996, 31.1 percent higher than in 1994/95.
Telstra said capital expenditure rose 22.1 percent to A$4.093 billion, primarily due to a substantial upgrades and expansions to Telstra's networks.
